requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 180 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with >= 180. The 14-person capacity is not converted into an area filter, since no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was supplied. Turin is a location and is handled by the Location Agent, so comune_code is not set.

The user prefers properties near public transport (metro, bus, stations). 'Preferred' signals a convenience need, so the threshold is set at the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71).

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Attività scolastiche' AND surface_area >= 180 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND mobility >= 71 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on property_type 'Attività scolastiche', surface_area >= 180, a 3.0 km haversine radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892), and mobility >= 71. Energy and capacity are not in the extracted requirements, so they are not filtered. Results are ordered by distance from the coordinates, ascending.
